name: Gaming
description: The native Linux gaming stack: launchers, the Wine and Proton compatibility layer, DirectX-to-Vulkan translation, performance overlays, controller support, a Wayland-friendly Discord, and console emulators for every system with a proven package. Ryoku's hardware layer installs the matching 32-bit GPU drivers, so games run at full hardware capacity.
